summary: Coach Card Analytics Testing Complete - All 9/9 backend tests passed. Found and FIXED a frontend bug where CoachCardConfig wasn't unwrapping axios response (missing .data). After fix, analytics section displays correctly showing total views, unique visitors, 7-day bar chart, and last viewed timestamp.

issues: Clean display with total/unique counts, 7-day bar chart, last viewed timestamp

passed_tests: POST /api/card/{slug}/view records a view and increments view_count (200)
GET /api/coach-card/{program_id}/analytics returns total_views, unique_visitors, recent_views, views_by_day
Analytics recent_views contain viewed_at, referer, visitor_hash
Analytics views_by_day is dict keyed by YYYY-MM-DD
Analytics for nonexistent program returns zero analytics (not 404)
Recording a view updates analytics (total_views increments)
Public Coach Card page fires POST /api/card/{slug}/view on load
CoachCardConfig shows analytics section when total_views > 0

bugs_fixed.issue: axios response not unwrapped - api.get().then(c => setConfig(c)) should be api.get().then(res => setConfig(res.data))
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed all api.get/put calls to unwrap response.data before setting state

critical_code_review_comments: Backend view tracking endpoint correctly uses fire-and-forget pattern
Analytics endpoint properly calculates unique visitors from visitor_hash
views_by_day calculation correctly filters last 7 days
Frontend now correctly unwraps axios responses in CoachCardConfig
